heroHeadline: OAS Chief Ramdin Presses for Foreign Ministers' Meeting to Deliver Sanctions 'Not Just Condemnation' as Tentative Sept. 17 Session Remains Unconfirmed
heroSubtitle: OAS Secretary General Albert Ramdin said September 10 that the long-delayed foreign ministers' meeting on Nicaragua — approved 29-1 by the Permanent Council in August — must produce financial sanctions and travel bans against Ortega-Murillo officials rather than another statement of disapproval, though a tentative September 17 Washington date remained unconfirmed amid divisions among Mexico, Brazil and Canada; exile-based rights group Ruta del Cambio separately branded the September 1 constitutional reform 'the formalization of the usurpation of power.'
